sn45.19:1.2: “Friend Ānanda, it is said, ‘the holy life, the holy life.’
sn45.19:1.3: What now, friend, is the holy life and what is the final goal of the holy life?”
sn45.19:1.5: Your intelligence is excellent, friend Bhadda, your ingenuity is excellent, your inquiry is a good one.
sn45.19:1.7: ‘Friend Ānanda, it is said, “the holy life, the holy life.”
sn45.19:1.8: What now, friend, is the holy life and what is the final goal of the holy life?’”
sn45.19:1.10: “This Noble Eightfold Path, friend, is the holy life; that is,
sn45.19:1.12: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion:
sn45.19:1.13: this, friend, is the final goal of the holy life.”
